summary: netapp.ontap in Ansible 13.5.0 added REST-only na_ontap_autoupdate_config and na_ontap_cg (ONTAP 9.10.1+) and AWS Lambda support for CIFS, igroup, LUN, S3, snapmirror and volume modules.
questions: How do I manage ONTAP consistency groups with Ansible?
Which netapp.ontap CIFS modules support AWS Lambda?
What ONTAP version does na_ontap_cg need?

answer_card.title: netapp.ontap 13.5.0 changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `na_ontap_autoupdate_config`: REST-only management of automatic update configs, ONTAP **9.10.1+**.
- `na_ontap_cg`: REST-only **consistency group** management, ONTAP **9.10.1+**.
- AWS Lambda support added to CIFS modules (`na_ontap_cifs`, `_acl`, `_local_group(_member)`, `_local_user(_set_password)`, `_privileges`, `_server`, `_unix_symlink_mapping`), `na_ontap_cluster_peer`, `na_ontap_igroup(_initiator)`, LUN copy/map modules, S3 buckets/groups/policies/services/users, `na_ontap_snapmirror`, `na_ontap_volume_autosize`, `na_ontap_volume_clone` and `na_ontap_vserver_peer`.
